pr_title: mgmt: mcumgr: Add runtime taskstat tick usage
pr_body:
Adds the runtime tick count of threads to mcumgr's taskstat response,
if CONFIG_SCHED_THREAD_USAGE is enabled, which reports the number of
execution cycles that each thread has been running for.

Fixes #40854

Is using https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/49513 as a base so has a commit from that PR too

`Will need documentation update PR to be added`

issue_context.title: mgmt/mcumgr/lib: Extend taskstat response with "runtime" statistics
issue_context.body:
**Is your enhancement proposal related to a problem? Please describe.**
The taskstat os mgmt command response carries "runtime" field which is supposed to carry "ticks" used by thread so far.
It is possible to gather the information from Zephyr, although some additional work may be required on kernel side, so this information should also be given in response.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
The "runtime" field in taskstat response should carry ticks of thread runtime used so far.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Leaving the information as unsupported.

**Additional context**
There is one problem with getting that information currently: the mcumgr lib passes around `const struct k_thread *`, which is ok since it is supposed to only read the structures only; unfortunately the `k_thread_runtime_stats_get` function, which is only API call that allows to obtain the data, requires pointer to non-const `struct k_thread`, because underneath, to gather the info, it calls function that actually modify the structure.
There is some work needed to provide function that will gather the info without calling modifiers.

review_comments: Shouldn't this be dependent on `CONFIG_OS_MGMT_TASKSTAT_ONLY_SUPPORTED_STATS`, at all, when `CONFIG_SCHED_THREAD_USAGE` is not enabled this is unsupported stat.
